notes: This is a free teen center, not a paid job. Future Corps for high schoolers meets the first Monday of each month, 4 to 6 PM, and helps with first-job support. Neutral Zone is at 310 E Washington St, Ann Arbor.
name: Neutral Zone free teen programs and youth-led projects
what_you_do: Drop in after school or join weekly programs. Some are music production, running a concert venue, game design, and first job and college planning. Teens can also start their own project.
who_can_apply: Any teen of high school age. It is best to sign up ahead, but you can sign up when you come.
deadline_text: School year 2026-27 programs run weekdays. Drop-in is Monday to Friday, 2 to 6 PM. No deadline is posted.
how_to_apply: Fill out the teen sign up form on the website or sign up when you come. Questions: Hananiah Wiggins, hananiah@neutral-zone.org, (734) 214-9995.
